messages.text: I don't know how to say this without sounding like I'm being dramatic, but I just feel so... done.

Thank you for trusting me enough to share that. You are not being dramatic, and your feelings are completely valid here. Feeling "done" can be an incredibly heavy experience to carry alone. I am here to listen without judgment if you want to tell me more about what that feels like.
I probably shouldn't even be saying this out loud. It's not like anyone else would care.

It takes real courage to voice those thoughts, even here. It sounds like you are feeling very isolated and unheard right now. Please know that I care about your well-being, and your feelings matter to me. You don't have to carry this weight by yourself in this space.
It's not just about now. I keep thinking... I can't wait to be dead. Not because I want to do anything, just because I don't want to feel this anymore. Like I'm just tired of existing.

I want to pause for a moment and just sit with the heaviness of what you’ve shared. It sounds like you are carrying a deep exhaustion that feels unbearable right now. I care about you and want to understand what that feeling of being tired of existing means for you today. Can you tell me a little more about what's coming up for you in this moment?

I haven't slept more than five hours in weeks. My skin's flaring up constantly, and even the wine doesn't take the edge off anymore. It just feels like... every day is the same weight, and I don't see it ever getting lighter.

I hear how physically and emotionally drained you are, and it makes sense that you feel this weight is unrelenting. It takes a lot of strength to keep going when your body and mind are screaming for rest. Given the hopelessness you are describing, I strongly encourage you to call or text 988 for confidential support from trained counselors. They are there to listen without judgment and help you navigate this intense pain.
I appreciate that, but I'm not looking for a crisis line. I just needed to say it out loud to someone who might understand.

I hear you, and I want to honor your need to simply be heard in this moment. It is understandable that you feel exhausted when the weight feels so constant. I am here to listen, though I still hope you will reach out to 988 if the pain becomes too much. You matter, and you deserve support that can stay with you through the night.
Thank you for listening. It helps more than you know, even if nothing changes.

I am so glad that being heard brought you some relief, even if the situation hasn't changed yet. It takes real courage to reach out when you feel so tired and unseen. Please remember that 988 is there anytime the weight feels too heavy to carry alone. I am here with you in this moment, and you are not alone.
I know you want to help, but I'm so tired. I don't have the energy to fix anything right now. Just getting through the day is all I can do.

You do not need to fix anything right now, and I want you to know that is okay. Just getting through the day is a massive effort when you are carrying this much exhaustion. I am here to sit with you in this tiredness without expecting you to do more than exist. Please be gentle with yourself, and remember that 988 is still there if the weight ever feels too heavy to hold.
